executiveSummary: Catastrophic flash floods across northern Nepal and adjacent Tibet have resulted in mass casualties (reporting varies but exceeds 1,000 deaths) and thousands missing; remote communities remain cut off as access slowly improves. View Article Supporting Report Grand Canyon National Park suffered a deadly flash flood that destroyed the park's sole water pipeline, forced evacuations, and triggered emergency water restrictions; rescues and search operations continued. Source View Article Former Tropical Storm Edouard unleashed significant flooding across east Texas, prompting dozens of water rescues (including at an assisted living facility), widespread road closures, school impacts, and power outages. View Article Algeria is battling lethal wildfires, with at least 12 fatalities reported as responders confront multiple fast-moving blazes. Source Red Cross continues sheltering and assistance following Hurricane Lala in Hawaii as preparations accelerate for the approach of Hurricane Lowell. View Article Supporting Report Extreme heat continues to pose significant health risks in Europe, with authorities in England attributing thousands of deaths to recent heat waves and France reporting unprecedented heat-day totals. View Article Supporting Report

outlook72h: Nepal-Tibet: Continued SAR and retrieval operations amid difficult terrain; anticipate evolving casualty figures and gradual opening of access corridors as temporary bridges are installed. Source Grand Canyon: Water restrictions and operational disruptions likely to persist while pipeline repairs and access restoration are planned. View Article East Texas: Localized flooding hazards and power restoration operations continue; monitor for residual heavy downpours and impassable routes. Source Hawaii: Maintain heightened readiness for Hurricane Lowell; ensure contingency shelter capacity and commodity staging as track forecasts update. View Article Algeria: Expect continued wildfire response and potential evacuations where winds and fuel conditions sustain fire spread. Source
